about.title: About Me
about.bio_p1: I'm a <0>Computer Science Engineering graduate and software engineer</0> passionate about building applications, automation solutions, and exploring AI technologies. My journey started with web development and programming, gradually growing into software testing, automation, and intelligent systems.
about.bio_p2: With hands-on experience in <0>Java, Playwright, Python, and full-stack development</0>, I enjoy creating projects, automating repetitive tasks, and solving real-world problems through technology. Outside of coding, I'm continuously learning new tools, exploring AI, experimenting with creative ideas, and building projects that turn concepts into reality.
about.bio_p3: I'm passionate about <0>software engineering, AI-powered automation, and continuous learning</0>. Whether I'm developing an application, designing an automation workflow, or exploring new technologies, I believe in combining creativity, curiosity, and technical skills to build meaningful digital experiences.
